name: Indus Valley Script
notes: origin_type is conditional: IF this is writing, INDEPENDENT is the best-supported classification (no evidence of derivation from Mesopotamian cuneiform or Egyptian hieroglyphs, despite documented Indus-Mesopotamia trade contact via "Meluhha"). But whether the ~400-sign corpus constitutes writing at all is a live, unresolved dispute — see claim_indus_writing_status_disputed. Precursor sign-like marks on Ravi-phase pottery go back to c. 3900-2800 BCE and are treated as proto-signs, not confirmed script.
